visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long reddish-brown hair stands on an outdoor rooftop terrace under bright natural sunlight. She wears an orange sports crop top and olive green cargo pants. She faces the camera, speaking with active facial expressions while the city skyline and glass railings are visible behind her. (2) The scene cuts to the same woman dressed in a traditional pale yellow scholar's robe with a wide belt. She wears a bald cap with black hair on the sides and a drawn-on mustache. She holds a green leaf-wrapped zongzi (rice dumpling) while performing rhythmic, exaggerated dance movements against the rooftop background. Animated hearts and light-effect overlays appear around her. (3) The character continues the energetic dance, now with rapidly changing animated background graphics featuring colorful heart concentric rings and floating sparkle effects. She makes humorous, high-energy facial expressions, including winking and pouting, while maintaining the costume. (4) The setting returns to the rooftop. Still in the scholar costume, the woman leans toward the camera, squinting her eyes and forcefully blowing air through her lips, causing them to vibrate visibly as the video ends.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To celebrate the Dragon Boat Festival (Duanwu) through a humorous cross-cultural meme adaptation. The creator uses a Japanese trend song and character roleplay (Qu Yuan) to deliver puns and holiday greetings, appealing to youth internet culture.
